**Finding: compliant** (no redline).

- **§ 8.2** — automatic renewals are limited to successive **twelve-month** periods (no multi-year auto-renewal), Customer may opt out on **30 days'** written notice, and Vendor must send a **60-day** renewal reminder. The clause goes slightly further in our favour by extending the opt-out deadline to 30 days after a late reminder is received.
- **§ 8.3** — renewal uplift is capped at the **lesser of CPI and 3%**, with 90 days' notice and no increase on prepaid periods.
- **§ 8.1** — three-year initial term with Order Forms surviving expiry; this is the initial term, not a renewal mechanic, so it does not engage the walk-away trigger on automatic multi-year renewals.

Together these meet the **preferred** position on all material terms (renewal length, notice window, reminder, price cap), so I have recorded it as compliant rather than proposing an edit.
